crossRefs.note: Then Yahweh said to me, “Out of the north, evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land.
Yahweh says, “Behold, a people comes from the north country. A great nation will be stirred up from the uttermost parts…
The voice of news, behold, it comes, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah a…
For, behold, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, that march through the width of the earth, to…
But if you will not hear it, my soul will weep in secret for your pride. My eye will weep bitterly, and run down with…
Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says against the shepherds who feed my people: “You have scattered my flock…
All you animals of the field, come to devour, all you animals in the forest.
For, behold, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, who will not visit those who are cut off, neither will seek those…
Woe to the worthless shepherd who leaves the flock! The sword will be on his arm, and on his right eye. His arm will be…
He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and…
The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand, and doesn’t care for the sheep.
Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,

translations.web: Lift up your eyes, and see those who come from the north. Where is the flock that was given to you, your beautiful flock?
translations.bsb: Lift up your eyes and see those coming from the north. Where is the flock entrusted to you, the sheep that were your pride?
translations.kjv: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given thee, thy beautiful flock?
translations.asv: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given thee, thy beautiful flock?
